tei:div.tei:p: "$ (243)༄// theg pa chen po blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig blo dman 'jug bder bkod pa byang chub gzhung lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(244)༄༅// gu ru buddha bo dhi sa twe bhye na ma// byams pa'i 'khor lo sngon tu 'gro// don gnyis phyogs las rnam par rgyal// thub mchog zhabs kyi padmo ni// mi phyed dad pas gtsug tu bcing*// dpa' bo snying rje'i gru bzung nas// srid 'gro sdug bsngal mtsho las sgrol// 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs// grags chen rgyal ba'i sras la 'dud// stong nyid snying rje'i lam bzang ston// bla na med pa'i dge ba'i bshes// rgyal ba kun gyi 'dren pa ni// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag bgyi'o// sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod gcig lam// go bar sla bas bslad med la// lag len bde bas 'jug par spro// zab pas sangs rgyas 'grub de 'chad// 'dir byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i man ngag khyad par du 'phags pa blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid ston pa la gsum/ brgyud pa'i byung khungs/ spyi'i dgos don/ khrid gzhung dngos 'chad pa'o// dang po ni/ thub dbang sras dang bcas pa'i thugs kyi man ngag snyan nas snyan tu brgyud de byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa dang*/ rang gi sku sha dngos su sbyin cing byams snying rje la brten nas stong nyid rtogs pa bla ma dharma rakṣi ta dang*/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang la dngos su (245)len nus pa bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa gsum las jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas yun ring du 'bad rtsol chen po'i tshul gyis rdzogs par gsan nas byang chub sems kyis thugs rgyud gtams/ bod kyi mgon tu phebs nas chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa zhig kyang tshul 'di kho na la brten nas bskor/ rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya mtha' las pa byang grol du bkod pa las/ slob ma'i gtso bo khu rngog 'brom gsum dang*/ de las kyang spyan ras gzigs dngos 'brom ston rin po che'i zhal slob rigs gsum sprul pa sku mched gsum la/

gzhung*/ gdams ngag /man ngag gsum gyi bka' so sor babs pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams las rim par brgyud de/ bka' gdams gzhung drug bshad srol gyi bka' dge lugs pa la babs// bden bzhi gdams ngag tu ston pa'i bka' dwags brgyud pa la babs/ man ngag thig le bcu drug gi bka' srol gnyis kas skyong bar bzhed// de ltar lha chos bdun ldan gyi bstan pa'i bdag po bka' gdams rin po cher grags pa/ lha bzhis lus brgyan/ sde snod gsum gyis ngag brgyan/ bslab pa gsum gyis sems brgyan pa'i bka' rgyud rin po che 'di la/ mdo lugs rang (246)rkang dang*/ sngags dang cung zad 'brel ba'i gdams ngag mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa thams cad kyang stong nyid snying rje zung 'brel gyi lam ston pa sha stag yin mod/ gtso bor kun rdzob byang sems kyi bka' babs pas brgyud 'dzin skyes chen phal mo ches bdag gzhan brje ba'i man ngag dang rnam thar rtsal du bton cing*/ de la'ang khrid tshul gyi phyag srol 'dra min mang ba las/ don bdun ma 'di ni bya 'chad ka ba chen po ye shes rdo rje'i gdams pa'i bka' srol las byon pa lags so// gnyis pa ni// mtho ris lha mi'i bde 'bras la snying po med pa lta zhog /nyan rang gi byang chub thob kyang myang 'das mthar thug ma yin pas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang kho na don tu gnyer dgos/ de 'thob par byed pa la byams snying rje la blo sbyong ba kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ spros bral rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom pa de gnyis la mi brten pa'i thabs gzhan yod pa ma yin te/ 'phags pa klus/ bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis// bla med byang chub thob 'dod na// de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems// ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang*// phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang*// gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags// zhes gsungs so// de'ang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnams kyang gang dang ldan na mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sogs theg pa chen po'i grangs su chud pa'i rtsa ba ni sems bskyed pa kho na yin cing*/

de'ang byams snying rje la brten nas skye ba dang*/ mthar thug gi sangs rgyas thob pa na'ang dmigs med snying rjes gzhan don nyag gcig mdzad pa las ci'ang byar yod pa ma yin pa dang*/ las dang po pa'i rgyud la don dam byang sems ji bzhin pa mi skye zhing*/ kun rdzob byang sems (247)sbyong na nges par skye la/ de skyes pas don dam byang sems rang shugs su rtogs par 'gyur ba sogs sgo du ma nas thog mar sems bskyed pa'i don 'bras kun rdzob byang chub sems nan tan tu bsgom dgos la/ de'i gdams ngag 'dun pas sbyong ba'i thabs kyi rtsa ba ni/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni// myur du bskyab par 'dod pa des// bdag dang gzhan tu brje bya ba// gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'og tu 'chad pa'i bdag gzhan brje ba'i bsgom rim kho na te/ blo sbyong rim pa gzhan rnams kyang 'di las 'phros pa'i yan lag sha stag go /gsum pa la gnyis/ gzhung khrid dngos 'chad pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i gdams pas kha skong pa'o// dang po la bdun/ sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bsten pa/ dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba/ tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bsten pa/ blo 'byongs pa'i tshad/ blo sbyong gi dam tshig /blo sbyong gi bslab bya'o// dang po ni/ thog mar sngon 'gro dag la bslab// ces gsungs te/ 'di la gnyis/ thun gyi sngon 'gro dang*/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro'o// dang po ni thun la 'jug pa'i thog ma thams cad du/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma zhal 'dzum bag /sku gzi brjid dang ldan zhing*/ thugs dmigs med snying rjes 'gro la dgongs te bzhugs pa/ rtsa brgyud bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsam/ mos gus dung dung ba'i ngang nas spro na brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyang bya/ khyad par du/ bla ma yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba lan brgya stong du (248)btab pa'i mthar/ bla ma de nyid rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas mar byon// snying 'od kyi gur khang sgang lkogs kha gyen bstan lta bur bzhugs par bsam la mos gus dung ba zhig bya ba ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor te thun 'go thams cad du gal che'o// gnyis pa ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa bzhi po khrid gsar ba yin na lam rim ltar rgyas par 'chad cing*/ rgyud la skye nges su bsgom dgos la/ dmigs pa'i rtsa ba mdor bsdus la mos na/ chos sgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di thob pa la rgyu dge ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub dgos/ sems can gyi nang na dge ba rnam dag bsgrub pa ches nyung bas 'bras bu dal 'byor thob pa dka'/ dud 'gro la sogs pa 'gro ba gzhan la ltos na mi lus thob pa srid tsam du 'dug pas// bdag gis da res mi lus lan cig thob pa 'di chud zos su mi btang bar chos rnam dag cig ci nas kyang bya/ de'ang tshe la nges pa med cing 'chi ba'i rkyen shin tu mang*/ de ring tsam yang mi 'chi bar 'dug pa'i gding yang med pas/ da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chos la 'bad dgos/ 'chi ba'i tshe dge sdig gnyis po ma gtogs zas nor longs spyod gnas lus dbang thang gang yang rjes su mi 'brang zhing phan pa spu tsam yang med pas cis kyang dgos pa med/ shi ba'i 'og tu las kyi dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig ma gtogs bde ba skra rtse tsam med/ dge sdig gi las las bde sdug gi 'bras bu 'byung ba ni bslu ba med pas sdig pa srog la bab kyang mi byed/ dge ba kho na 'bad pa chen pos bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa nan tan tu sbyang*/

thun mjug rnams su yan lag bdun pa ci nus dang*// (249)thun mtshams su dmigs pa'i don lag len tu 'debs pa ni sbyor dngos thams cad la 'gre bar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ don dam byang sems zhar byung du bsgom pa// kun rdzob byang sems gtso bor bsgom pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ thun dang thun mtshams so// dang po la sbyor ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor song nas/ lus drang por 'dug ste dbugs phyir 'gro dang nang 'gro lan nyer gcig gi bar du ma 'khrugs par bgrangs pas bsam gtan gyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ro// dngos gzhi ni/ chos rnams rmi lam lta bur bsam// zhes gsungs pas/ snod bcud dngos po'i chos gzung ba'i yul du snang ba 'di rnams rang gi sems kyi 'khrul snang kho na yin pas/ don la bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med de rmi lam gyi snang ba lta bu'o// zhes bsam la 'dun pa cung zad sbyang*/ sems nyid bden nam snyam na/ ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyad// ces gsungs te/ rang sems kyi ngo bo la cher gyis bltas pas kha dog dbyibs sogs gang du'ang ma grub cing byung ba'i khungs med pas dang por ma skyes/ da lta lus kyi phyi nang la sogs pa gang du'ang mi gnas/ mthar 'gro zhing 'gag pa'i yul med pa skye 'gag gnas bral gyi rig pa'i gshis la sems tshol gyi dpyad pas thag chod kyi nges shes thob par bya// de'i tshe lus sems thams cad stong pa'o snyam pa dang*/ stong pa la cis kyang phan gnod med do snyam pa sogs gnyen po'i rnam rtog byung na/ gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol// zhes gsungs te/ gnyen po bden med kyi 'dun pa de ga'i ngo bo bltas pas/ de nyid kyang gtad med rang sar grol ba de'i ngang du lhod kyis klod/ de dag ni dpyad sgom pa'i grub don man ngag tu bstan pa'o// ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang la bzhag /ces pa ni 'jog tshul dngos bstan pa ste/

rnam shes tshogs bdun gyi spro bsdu thams (250)cad dang phral nas/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo kun gzhi dang lugs dge ba bde gshegs snying po'i sgras bstan pa/ spros bral gsal la mi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi ngang du/ gshis cir yang ma grub pa la blos gang yang mi 'dzin par rang bab tu bzhag pa ste/ mdor na rnam rtog gi rjes su mi 'brang bar sems nyid gsal la rtog med kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa ni 'jog sgom pa'i bab so'o// rjes yan lag bdun pa sngar ltar dgye'o// gnyis pa ni/ thun mtshams sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya// zhes pas/ thun mtshams su spyod lam ci byed kyang mnyam bzhag gi nyams dang ma bral bar/ rang gzhan snod bcud gang snang thams cad med bzhin tu snang ba sgyu ma'i skyes bu ltar bden med du shes pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags su bskyed do// gnyis pa kun rdzob byang sems sgom pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ thun mtshams kyi chos so// dang po sngon 'gro sogs gong ltar la/ gtong len gyi gzhi byams snying rje bsgom dgos te/ de'ang thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i ma mdun du yod par dmigs/ 'dis bdag lto na gnas pa nas bzung ste 'bad rtsol chen pos bskyangs/ mo rang na tsha 'khyag ltogs thams cad bsran/ zas gos ster/ mi gtsang ba phyis/ bzang po bslab/ ngan pa las bzlog pas da lta sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal zhing chos sgrub tu yod pas shin tu drin che/ tshe 'dir kho nar ma zad tshe rabs dpag tu med pa rnams su'ang de kho na ltar byas nas/ bdag gi don byas pas 'di rang 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba snying rje snyam pa drag tu bsgom/ de nas kha tsam min pa'i snying rje skyes shing 'byangs nas rim par rgya je che la bslab ste/ sems can thams cad rtsa ba'i ma de ji lta ba bzhin tu thog ma med pa nas mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med phan ma btags pa med snyams pas (251)thog mar skye sla ba 'dza' bshes gnyen 'dun/

sdug bsngal shin tu che ba'i ngan song gsum// nyam thag pa'i mi/ tshe 'dir skyid kyang shi ma thag dmyal bar 'gro ba'i sdig po che rnams la bsgom/ de 'byongs nas skye dka' ba gnod byed dgra dang gdon sogs la bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad la bsgom// bdag gi pha ma mi 'dod bzhin tu sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba ma zad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu khams po che la longs spyod pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ ci tshug bya/ da ni ngas kyang 'di rnams kyi drin lan tu gnod pa bsal/ bde ba dang skyid pa byas nas phan gdags par bya'o snyam pa'i blo bsran mi bzod pa tsam du sbyong ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyangs// de nyid rlung la bskyon te bya// zhes gsungs te/ snying rje'i yul gyur pha ma de rnams la sdug bsngal gyis dngos su gnod/ kun 'byung gis brgyud nas gnod pas/ ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa dang*/ kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad bdag gis blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas de rnams thams cad rang la byung bar bsgom zhing*// byung na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba dang bde ba thams cad pha ma sems can thams cad la ltos pa med par btang bar bgyi'o snyam pas bde ba de rnams gzhan la re re bzhin thob par bsgom zhing thob na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya/ khyad par dmigs rnam gsal ba'i khyad/ rang gi dbugs nang du rngub pa dang bstun sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal ci yod pa thams cad nag 'ub kyis bsdus/ sna sgo nas zhugs/ rang gi snying nang du thim pas sems can rnams sdig sdug dang gtan bral du song bar bsam/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba na/ rang gi bde (252)ba dang dge ba ci yod pa thams cad zla zer lta bu'i rnam pas sna sgo nas dkar lam gyis song sems can thams cad la thim/ de rnams 'phral de las sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bsam zhing dga' ba'ang bsgom/

de ltar rlung la gtong len bskyon pa 'di nyid thun gyi dngos gzhir byas te sbyang*/ phyis su'ang dran pas nam zin zin la nyams su len/ blo sbyong gi dngos gzhi 'di nyid yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na// sangs rgyas nyid ni mi 'grub cing*// 'khor ba na yang bde ba med// ces sogs rgya cher gsungs so// gsum pa thun mtshams kyi nyams len ni/ yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsum// zhes pa ni/ yul yid du 'ong ba dang phan 'dogs pa la zhen chags/ yid du mi 'ong ba dang gnod byed la zhe sdang*/ bar ma la ci'ang mi bsam pa'i gti mug ste yul gsum la brten nas dug gsum rgyun chags su 'byung bas// de ma thag ngos zin par byas la/ dper na 'dod chags skyes pa'i tshe// sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa 'dod chags ji snyed pa thams cad bdag gi 'di la 'dus par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'dod chags med pa'i dge rtsa dang ldan par gyur cig /de rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i go bdag gi 'dis chod nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du nyon mongs pa dang bral bar gyur cig /snyam du bsam/ zhe sdang sogs la'ang des 'gres te lam du khyer bas dug gsum dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' yas pa gsum du 'gyur ro// spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyong*// zhes pas/ dus thams cad du/ bdag la de dag sdig smin cing*// bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces 'phags pa'i gsung dang*/ khe dang rgyal kha thams cad jo bo sems can pa rnams la 'bul lo// gyong dang bub kha thams cad bdag gis blang bar bgyi'o// zhes (253)bka' gdams pa'i gsung sgros las byung ba dang*/ sems can rnams kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin cing*/ bdag gi dge ba dang bde ba thams cad sems can rnams la smin par gyur cig /ces rgyal sras thogs med gsung ste de lta bu gang rung brjod cing 'dun pa drag tu bya/

len pa'i go rims rang nas brtsam// zhes pas/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang la len nus pa'i phyir/ go rim gyi thog mar rang nas brtsam te/ rang la ma 'ongs par smin 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal thams cad da lta yid kyis blangs la/ de byang nas gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rnams blang ngo*// gsum pa lam khyer ni/ snod bcud sdig pas gang ba'i tshe// rkyen ngan byang chub lam du bsgyur// zhes gsungs te/ snod kyi dpal 'byor nyams pa dang*// bcud kyi sems can ma rungs pas 'tshe ba sogs sdig pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal mang pos gang ba'i tshe/ thog tu bab pa'i rkyen ngan de dag byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur dgos pas/ de la gsum/ kun rdzob byang sems la brten pa/ don dam byang sems la brten pa/ spyod pa khyad par can la brten pa'o// dang po ni/ le len thams cad gcig la bda'o// zhes pas/ rang gi lus la na tsha/ sems kyi sdug bsngal/ mi kha skur 'debs/ dgra gyod kha mchu/ mdor na rang dang rang phyogs la mi 'dod pa che phra ci byung yang*/ 'dis gnod pa byas so snyam pa'i le lan gzhan la mi bda' bar/ bdag med pa la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems 'dis/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du rang 'dod kho nas mi dge ba sna tshogs byas pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'di rnams thog tu babs pa yin pas/ gzhan su'ang ma lan gyi/ bdag gces 'dzin 'dis lan pas 'di gcig pu ci thul bya'o snyam pas/ chos thams cad bdag 'dzin gyi thog tu rtsal (254)sprugs la btang ste/ spyod 'jug las/ 'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang*// 'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod gyur pa// de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na// 'dre chen des ko bdag la ci zhig bya// zhes dang*/ 'di yis brgya phrag thams cad du// 'khor bar bdag la gnod pa byas// da ni 'khon rnams dran byas te// khyod kyi rang sems ngan pa gzhom// zhes sogs gsungs so// kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom// zhes pas/

spyir sangs rgyas sgrub pa ni yul sems can rnams la ma bsten par sgrub pa'i thabs med pas byang chub 'dod pa'i gang zag la sangs rgyas dang sems can bka' drin mnyam/ khyad par sems can thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas drin che/ yang dgos gnod byed la sogs pa 'di rnams bdag gi tshogs bsags dang sgrib sbyong gi grogs dang dpung gnyen yin pas shin tu bka' drin che snyam du bsam la gtong len bsgom/ tha na khyi dang 'bu srin yan chad la khong mi khro bar dngos su phan ci thogs la 'bad/ mi nus na sems can rnam/ gnod byed 'di myur du sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba dang ldan/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas ngag tu'ang brjod/ yang da phyin chad/ bdag gis dge ba ci byed thams cad 'di'i don tu bya'o snyam du sems bskyed/ lha 'dre la/ thog ma med pa nas bdag gis 'di la gnod pa bskyal bas gnod pa byung*/ da res de'i lan tu sha khrag la sogs pa sbyin no snyam pas/ gnod byed de'i mdun tu rang lus blos btang la/ bdag gi sha khrag la sogs pa gang 'dod khyod kyis rol cig ces brjod cing*/ blos lings kyis bskyur bas/ gnod byed des sha khrag la sogs pa longs spyod pas rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis (255)skyes par bsgom/ yang*/ bdag gnyen po dang bral nas nyon mongs pa skyes pa ma tshor ba la/ gnod byed 'dis sbran pas 'di bla ma'am sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin nges te/ bdag gi byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba'i bskul ma byas pas shin tu bka' drin che snyam du bsam/ yang*/ nad dang sdug bsngal byung na/ 'di ma byung na bdag tshe 'di'i bya bas g.yengs te chos mi dran par 'dug /'dis chos dran tu bcug pas bla ma dkon mchog gi phrin las yin bka' drin che snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam/ mdor na rang don sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor su la yod pa de 'jig rten khyim pa yin cing*/

gzhan don sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor su la yod pa de chos pa yin pas/ gling ri thang pa'i zhal nas/ ngas ji tsam gyi chos zab mo zhig zhal phye ste bltas kyang skyon thams cad rang gi yin par 'dug /yon tan thams cad jo bo sems can gyi yin par 'dug /de'i gnad kas khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la sbyin/ gyong dang bub ka rang gis len pa 'di min pa go rgyu med gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khrul snang sku bzhir lta ba yi// stong nyid srung ba bla na med// ces gsungs te/ spyir snang ba thams cad dang*/ sgos rkyen ngan de'ang rmi lam du mes 'tshig pa'am chus khyer nas nyam thag pa ltar/ rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba mi bden pa la bden par bzung ba ste/ snang yang bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa thag bcad/ snang tsam de 'dzin med kyi ngang la bzhag pas/ ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ rnam pa gsal ba sprul sku/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa longs sku/ de rnams dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ skye 'gag gnas gsum ngos bzung dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag /lta ba'i go cha/ stong nyid kyi srung 'khor ces 'khrul snang (256)gcod pa'i man ngag bla na med pa'o// gsum pa ni/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog /ces gsungs te/ de'ang tshogs bsags pa'i sbyor ba/ sdig pa bshags pa'i sbyor ba/ lha 'dre la gtor ma sbyin pa/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan pa ni/ rkyen ngan lam du byed pa'i thabs rnams kyi mchog yin/ de la dang po ni/ bdag 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang*/ 'ong ba sdug bsngal kho na 'ong ba 'dir sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa spongs/ bde skyid kyi rgyu tshogs sogs shig pa'i brdar 'dug pas de ltar bya'o snyam pas/ bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ 'byung po'i gtor ma/ mar me sātstsha phyag bskor sogs lus ngag yid gsum gyi tshogs gsog ci 'grub dang*/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ khyad par yan lag bdun pa dang maṇḍal la 'bad/ bdag na ba legs na na bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sos pa legs na sos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shi ba legs na shi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa ni/ 'dun pa sngar ltar la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed snyam pa nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa rten gyi stobs/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa dang*/ gzungs sngags khyad par can zlos pa sogs gnyen po'i sgo drug la 'bad cing re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol 'debs byed pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs bzhi po tshad du longs par bya/ gsum pa ni/ gnod byed la gtor ma sbyin/ khyed kyis sngar bdag gi lan chags bsnyag tu phyin cing bu lon khyer bar byed pa shin tu bka' drin che/ da dung bdag brlag par mdzad du gsol/ sems (257)can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa nad byur chags nyam nga thams cad bdag la smin par mdzad du gsol/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar mdzod cig /ces phrin las bcol/ de ltar mi nus na/ gtor ma btang*/ byams snying rje gtong len bsgom la/ ngas khyod la 'phral dang yun tu gang phan pa bya yis/ nga'i chos kyi bar chad ma byed cig /ces bka' bsgos/ bzhi pa ni/ chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul/ chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen 'grub pa'i phrin las bcol/ khyad par gong smos re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol 'debs bya'o// rkyen glo bur ba lam du slong ba'i phyir// 'phral la gang thug bsgom du sbyar// zhes pas/ glo bur du na tsha gdon bgegs nyon mongs pa sogs rang la byung ba'am/ gzhan la mi 'dod pas gces pa mthong na gtong len kho na bya'o snyam pa dang*/

dge ba sogs rang gi bsam sbyor legs pa kun la/ sems can thams cad 'di bas kyang ches lhag pa'i chos kyi bya ba la ngang gis 'jug par gyur cig snyam pa dang*/ bde ba dang skyid pa byung na'ang de bzhin tu sbyar/ gal te rnam rtog ngan pa skye ba'am/ dbang med du bya ba ngan pa la 'jug dgos pa byung na/ sems can thams cad kyi rnam rtog ngan pa'am/ bya ba ngan pa thams cad bdag gi 'di la 'dus par gyur cig snyam du bsam/ mdor na za nyal 'gro 'chag spyod lam ci byed kyang gzhan phan gyi bsam pas zin par byas nas/ 'phral la rkyen bzang ngan gang thug kyang blo sbyong gi bsgom kho nar sbyang bar bya'o// bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa la gnyis// tshe 'dir ji ltar bya ba dang*/ 'chi kar ji ltar bya ba'o// dang po ni/ man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pa// stobs lnga dag dang sbyar bar bya// zhes pa ste/ dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa'i man ngag zab dgu gcig dril nyams len gnad 'gag (258)mdor bsdu na stobs lnga ste/ dang po 'phen pa'i stobs ni/ dus 'di nas bzung ste sangs ma rgyas kyi bar dang khyad par ma shi'i bar dang*/ sgos su lo 'di dang zla ba 'di/ yang sgos de ring nas sang gi bar du byang chub kyi sems gnyis ngang gtan nas mi 'bral bar bya'o// zhes blo'i 'phen pa drag po btang*/ gnyis pa goms pa'i stobs ni/ spyod lam mam/ dge sdig lung ma bstan gyi bya ba ci zhig la 'jug gi 'dug kyang dran shes kyis krig gis bzung nas byang chub kyi sems gnyis ma bral bar yang dang yang du sbyang ba ste/ mdor na dge sbyor gyi gtso bo byang chub sems la bslab pa'o// gsum pa dkar po'i sa bon gyi stobs ni/ byang chub kyi sems skye ba dang 'phel ba'i don tu dge ba la chog shes med par lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la rtag tu 'bungs pa'o// bzhi pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ bdag gces 'dzin gyi rnam rtog nam byung ba na/

sngar yang thog cha med pa nas 'khor bar 'khyams/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba khyod kyis len/ tshe 'dir yang sdig pa sdug bsngal ji snyed byung ba thams cad 'di kho nas len/ da yang khyod dang 'grogs na skyid med/ da res 'di ci brlag ci thul bya dgos snyam pas bdag 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rgyangs kyis spang ba'o// lnga pa smon lam gyi stobs ni/ dge sbyor gang byed kyi gsham du/ spyir sems can thams cad bdag kho nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'dren nus par gyur cig /khyad par dus 'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis rmi lam du'ang mi brjed cing gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog cig /rkyen ngan ci byung yang byang chub sems kyi grogs su khyer nus par gyur cig /ces zhe thag pa nas gdab cing*/ dge ba thams cad de'i don du bsngo bar bya'o// gnyis pa chos 'di'i lugs kyi 'da' kha ma'i gdams ngag ji ltar byed ce na/ theg chen 'phel ba'i gdags ngag ni/ (259)stobs lnga nyid yin spyod lam gces// zhes pa ste/ chos 'di la sbyangs pa'i gang zag 'chi nges pa'i nad kyis thebs pa'i tshe/ dang por/ yo byad ci yod pa thams cad spyir bla ma dkon mchog sgos rang nyid phan yon 'di rang che snyam pa'i phyogs su btang la chags zhen 'khri ba spu rtse tsam med par byed pa dkar po'i sa bon gyi stobs/ nus na yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ mi nus na'ang bdag gi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji yod pa'i mthus/ bdag skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems rin po che mi brjed cing sbyangs nas gong du 'phel bar gyur cig /chos 'di ston pa'i bla ma yang dag pa dang mjal bar gyur cig /de ltar 'grub pa bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po ches byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes yid rtse gcig pas smon pa smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ bdag gces 'dzin 'dis skye ba grangs med par sdug tu bcug

/da ras kyang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal myong*/ don dam par bdag dang sems ma grub pas 'chi rgyu med/ na'o 'chi'o bsam pa'i bdag 'dzin khyod ci nas brlag par bya'o snyam pa sogs sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/ 'chi kha dang bar do dang skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis dang ma bral bar bya'o snyam pa 'phen pa'i stobs dang*/ sngar bsgom pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis gsal 'debs pa ni goms pa'i stobs yin pas/ gtso bor de dag rtse gcig tu bya zhing*/ grogs su sbyong lam yang gces te lus gnang chos bdun nam/ mi nus na gzhog g.yas 'og tu bcug /lag pa g.yas la 'gram pa brten pa'i mthe'u chung gis sna bug g.yas bkag /rlung g.yon nas rgyu bar byas la byams snying rje sngon tu 'gro bas rlung 'gro 'ong dang sbyar te gtong len sbyang*/ de'i rjes la 'khor 'das skye 'chi la sogs pa thams cad sems snang yin/ sems nyid cir yang ma grub par shes (260)pa'i ngang la blos cing yang mi 'dzin par bzhag /de dag gi ngang la dbugs 'gro nus par bya'o// 'chi kha'i gdams ngag 'ud che ba mang ste 'di las ngo mtshar ba med gsungs/ 'gron bu ma nyams pa'i bsreg thal/ rdo khab len gyi phye ma gnyis sbrang smyon la sbyar ba spyi bor byug pa'ang rdzas kyi 'pho ba'i man ngag yin no// lnga pa blo 'byangs pa'i tshad bstan pa ni/ chos kun dgos pa gcig tu 'dus// zhes gsungs te/ theg pa che chung gi chos thams cad kyi dgos pa ni bdag 'dzin 'dul ba gcig pur 'dus pas/ chos byas bzhin/ blo sbyong bsgom bzhin bdag gces 'dzin je chung du 'gro dgos/ bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song na chos byas tshad don med du song ba yin/ chos chos su 'gro mi 'gro'i rtsa ba 'di la thug pas/ 'di chos pa srang la 'jal ba'i rgya ma yin gsungs/ dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung*// zhes pa ni/ gzhan dag gis chos pa tshad ldan tu mthong ba yang dpang po yin mod kyi/

rang blo lkog gyur 'jig rten phal pas mi rtogs/ spyod lam legs pa sna res kyang mgu bar srid/ rang sems rang gis ma khrel ba zhig rtag tu byung na blo 'byangs pa'i rtags yin pas/ gzhan gyi dpang po la chags mi 'jog par/ rang sems kyi dpang po gtso bor bzung ngo*// yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun tu brten// zhes pa ni/ rkyen ngan sdug bsngal ci byung yang 'jigs sbag yi mug nam yang mi skye bar/ blo sbyong gi grogs su song nas yid bde 'ba' zhig pa dang rgyun tu 'grogs pa ni blo 'byangs pa'i tshad yin pas/ rkyen ngan gang byung yang de la dga' ba bsgom nas/ de'i steng du gzhan gyi rkyen ngan thams cad kyang dga' bzhin tu len pa la bslab par bya'o// yengs kyang thub na 'byangs pa yin// zhes pa ni/ dper na rta rtsal can de yengs kyang rta las mi ltung ba ltar glo bur du rkyen ngan byung ba na/ ched gtad dran pas ma bzung yang rkyen ngan de (261)nyid blo sbyong gi grogs su 'gro thub na 'byangs pa ste/ dgra gnyen gnod byed bde sdug ci snang thams cad kyi steng du/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis rtsol med lhang lhang skye ba'o// bzhi bo da byang chub sems 'byongs shing gnad du song ba'i rtags yin gyi/ sbyang mi dgos pa'i rtags yin zer ba min pas/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du gong 'phel la bslab bo// drug pa blo sbyong gi dam tshig ni/ spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab// ces gsungs te/ spyi don gsum ni/ blo sbyong khas blangs dang ma 'gal ba ste/ so thar byang sems sngags kyi bslab pa phra mo tshun chad rang gis gang blangs pa la nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos pa dang*/ thor chor ma shor ba ste/ bdag gces 'dzin med pa gzhan gyis go ru re bas/ lha rten bshig pa/ shing gnyan gcod pa/ chu gnyan dkrugs pa/ mdze sprang dang 'grogs pa sogs tho cho'i spyod pa spangs te rnam thar gtsang sing nge bar bya ba dang*/

phyogs rer ma lhung ba ste/ mi'i gnod pa bzod kyang lha 'dre'i gnod pa mi bzod pa dang*/ de go ldog pa dang*/ gnyen la bzod dgra la mi bzod pa dang*/ de rnams la bzod kyang na tsha sogs sdug bsngal la mi bzod pa dang*/ de thams cad bzod kyang skyid thog tu chos 'chor ba sogs blo sbyong phyogs re ba spang ba dam tshig yin pas rtag tu bslab par bya'o// 'dun pa bsgyur la rang sor bzhag /ces pa ni/ sngar rang gces gzhan mi gces pa'i 'dun pa de go ldog tu bsgyur la gzhan don kho nar gces par bzung*/ blo sbyong thams cad mngon tshan chung la sa chod che ba zhig bya dgos pas/ phyi'i sbyong lam chos mthun gyi grogs po gzhan rnams dang 'dra bar rang so thub par bzhag la/ gzhan gyis ma tshor bar rgyud smin pa zhig bya'o// yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya// zhes pas/ gzhan la 'jig rten gyi skyon zhar ba glen pa la sogs pa dang*/ chos kyi skyon (262)sdom pa nyams pa sogs mi snyan pa'i tshig mi brjod par zhi dal 'dzum dang bcas pas 'thad cing yid la 'bab pa'i tshig brjod do// gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo// zhes gzhan phyogs sems can spyi dang*/ khyad par chos sgor zhugs pa gang gi'ang skyon mi bsam ste/ skyon mthong ba de nga rang gi snang ba ma dag pas len/ khong la de 'dra med/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la'ang skyon tu mthong ba kha cig byung ba dang 'dra snyam du bsam la/ rang blo skyon can tshar bcad par bya'o// nyon mongs gang che sngon la sbyang*// zhes rang rgyud la nyon mongs gang che brtag la/ thog mar de'i steng du chos thams spungs nas 'dul zhing sbyang*/ 'bras bur re ba thams cad spangs// zhes blo sbyong bsgoms pas lha 'dre thul du re ba dang*/ rang bzang por mthong du re bas gnod lan tu phan gdags pa sogs tshul 'chos yin pas spang ste/ mdor na tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan grags/ phyi ma lha mi'i bde ba rang nyid mya ngan las 'das pa thob 'dod sogs rang don yid byed kyi 'bras bu la re ba thams cad spang ngo*// dug can gyi zas spang*/

zhes pa ni/ dngos po bden 'dzin dang*/ bdag gces 'dzin gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i dge sbyor thams cad kha zas dug can dang mtshungs pas spang la/ 'dzin med sgyu ma lta bu la bslab bo// gzhung bzang po ma bsten/ zhes pa na/ dper na 'jig rten pa'i mi gzhung bzang po can des sa phyogs dus tshod ji tsam song yang rang la ltos pa'i mi brjed pa med pa de bzhin tu/ rang la gnod pa byas pa la 'khon tu bzung nas 'khon 'dzin de las nam yang mi log pa de spangs la/ gnod pa'i lan tu slar yang phan 'dogs pa'i bsam sbyor dang ldan par bya'o// shag ngan ma rgod/ ces pa ni/ spyir gzhan gyi mtshang 'bru ba la dga' bar mi bya/ sgos su pha rol pos rang la tshig ngan smras pa'i lan du gzhan la gnod pa'i tshig mi smra ba ma zad/ nyes pa byung na'ang 'dis lan mi smra bar nam yang (263)gzhan gyi yon tan bsngags pa la brtson par bya'o// 'phrang ma sgugs/ ces pas/ gzhan gyi gnod pa byas pa zhe la bzhag nas lo mang po lon kyang ma brjed par gnod lan 'khyol ba'i 'phrang byung dus gnod skyel ba de spang nas gnod lan phan gang thogs btags pa ste/ gdon gyi gnod pa lta bu la'ang gnod 'dzin mi bya bar byams snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom/ gnad la mi dbab/ zhes mi'i skyon mtshang nas 'bru ba sogs gnad la bkar ba'i tshig dang*/ mi ma yin pa'i srog sngags 'dren pa sogs gzhan sems la zug rngu skyed pa'i tshig mi brjod/ mdzo khal glang la mi 'byo/ zhes pas/ rang la bab pa'i khag ngan gzhan la bskur ba dang*/ rang thog bab pa'i bya dka' ba g.yo sgyus gzhan gyi steng du bsgyur na/ mdzo'i rgyab khal glang la byo ba lta bu ste de ltar mi bya/ mgyogs kyi rtse mi gtod/ ces rta rgyugs pa'i tshe su mgyogs la blo rtse gtod pa bzhin chos pa 'dra 'dra'i nang du rnyed bkur snyan grags sogs rang la lhag par 'ong du re ba dang*/ zang zing gi rnyed pa thob pa'i thabs sna tshogs la brtson pa'i bsam sbyor spangs te/

rnyed bkur snyan grags byung ma byung la khyad med par bya'o// lto log mi bya/ zhes pas/ phug rang bzang bar 'dod nas 'phral pham kha len pa dang*/ nad gdon zhi dang rkyen ngan bzlog tu re nas blo sbyong byed na/ lto bcos bon gyer bzhin tu log pa'i chos su song ba yin pas de ltar mi bya bar skyid sdug gang byung yang re dogs snyems 'phrigs spangs te bsgom/ rgyal sras thogs med zhal nas/ tshan gcig gi rnam rtog la blo sbyong 'di/ 'dre gdon la phan pa'i thabs zhig tu go ba 'dra ste/ de tsug byed na bon byed pa dang khyad med/ chos bya ba nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ 'dis mtshon nas chos log zer ba'ang*/ rtag chad du lta ba lta log /mchog (264)'dzin gyi sgom pa sgom log /sdom pa gsum dang mi mthun pa spyod log ste/ dam pa'i chos tshad ma nas gsungs pa'i lta spyod dang 'gal ba rang gzhan mchog dman su la yod kyang chos log zer zhing 'khor ba dang ngan song du 'phen pa yin te/ dper na gcod log gam/ nad la sman log ces pa lta bu'o// gang zag kha cig gis sbyar ba'am/ gter nas byung ba 'ga' zhig chos log ces rtsom chos dang gter chos de dag yang dag dang log pa yin min le'u gcig gi tshig don la'ang ma dpyad par smra ba ni/ grub mtha' rang rang gi zhen phyogs sam/ gang zag gi gnas skabs la ltos nas bsgrags par snang mod/ gang zag gi rgyud tshod sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi bzung bar gsungs pas lta spyod tshad dang ldan phyin gang zag de la rang ma mgu yang de tsam gyis chos log tu bsgrub mi nus te/ dper na gser bzang po dang 'dra min gnyis 'tshong ba po mchog dman gyi khyad par med pa bzhin no// des na sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ gang zag la mi brton chos la brton/ zhes yang yang bka' bstsal pa ste 'di'ang go ba gal che snang ba ni 'phros su smos pa'o// lha bdud du mi dbab/

ces pas/ blo sbyong sgom bzhin nga rgyal dang rloms sems byas te rang rgyud rengs na/ lha bdud du bab pa dang 'dra bar chos chos min tu song ba yin pas// chos sam blo sbyong ji tsam sgom bzhin rang rgyud je thul du 'gro bar byas te/ kun la bran gyi tha ma ltar bya'o// skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma tshol/ zhes yon bdag sogs la na tsha shi chad byung na zas nor 'ong*/ grwa rogs grogs mched shi na dpe cha lha rten 'ong*/ rang dang mnyam pa shi na nga gcig pu la bsod nams 'ong*/ dgra shi na legs snyam pa sogs mdor na rang skyid pa'i yan lag tu gzhan la mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal yong du re ba spang bar bya dgos so// bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya (265)bstan pa ni// rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya// zhes gsungs te/ zas za ba/ gos gon pa/ nyal ba/ 'gro 'dug la sogs pa thams cad gzhan la phan gdags pa'i bsam pa dang mi 'bral ba'i rnal 'byor gcig pus lam du khyer// log non thams cad gcig gis bya// zhes dpyad kyi log gnon tu dpyad rang bya ba bzhin/ blo sbyong bsgom pa'i tshe na tsha rkyen ngan mang ba/ mi kha skur 'dabs zug pa/ 'dre gdon dgra gyod kyis 'tshe ba/ rang gi nyon mongs pa che ru song ba/ sgom snying mi 'dod pa sogs byung na/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag gi nyes pa 'di lta bu byung ba'i sems can mang po yod pas de rnams snying re rje snyam du bsam la/ mi 'dod pa 'di'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal thams cad 'dus par gyur cig snyam du bdag gzhan brje ba'i log non gcig pu bya'o// thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis// zhes pas thog ma nangs par ldang ma thag pa'i tshe/ de ring byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang ma bral bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa shugs drag po btang*/ nyin mo'ang dran pa rgyun chags kyis zin par byas mthar do nub nyal ba na de ring gi bsam sbyor rnams la brtags te byang chub kyi sems dang 'gal ba byung na rang la brngan bgrang ste bshags pa dang*/

phyin chad de ltar mi 'byung ba'i dam bca' bya/ ma 'gal bar 'dug na dga' ba bsgom zhing phyin chad rang gzhan thams cad de las ches lhag pa la 'jug nus pa'i smon lam gdab pa ste bya ba gnyis po de la dus rgyun tu bslab/ nyes ltung sdom pa sogs la'ang 'dun bsam de bzhin tu bya'o// gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya// zhes rang nyid shin tu sdug bsngal ba dang nyam thag pa byung na'ang sngon las su bsam ste zhe 'khod sems sdug mi bya bar gzhan gyi sdig sdug thams cad len cing sdig sgrib sbyong (266)ba'i thabs la 'bad/ 'khor dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa sogs bde skyid cher byung na'ang bag med btang snyoms kyi dbang du mi btang bar/ nor dge phyogs su btang*/ dbang thang dge bar bsgyur/ sems can thams cad bde skyid dang ldan par smon lam gdab/ mdor na bde sdug gnyis po gang byung yang bzod par bya/ gnyis po srog dang bsdos nas bsrung*// zhes sdom pa gsum sogs chos spyi'i bslab bya dang*/ blo sbyong gi sgos kyi bslab bya dang dam tshig tshul bzhin srung ba las 'di phyi'i bde ba thams cad 'byung bas dam tshig de gnyis srog dang bsdos nas bsrung*/ de'ang ci byed rang don gyi rnam rtog gi 'khri ba ma zhugs par gzhan phan gyi bsam pa kho nas bsrung ngo*// dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya// zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs pa dang por ngo shes pa dka'/ bar du bzlog par dka'/ mthar rgyun gcod par dka' bas/ dang por skyes ma thag nyon mongs pa yin pa ngos zin par bya/ bar du gnyen po'i stobs skyed nas spang*/ mthar phyin chad 'di lta bu gtan nas mi 'byung bar bya snyam pa'i zhe bcad de gsum po la bslab par bya'o// rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang*// zhes chos sgrub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma bzang po dang*/ rang gi blo las su rung bas chos tshul bzhin nyams su lon pa dang*/ zas gos sogs chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzom pa ste/

de gsum rang la 'dzom na dga' ba bsgom/ gzhan la'ang de gsum tshang bar smon lam gdab/ ma tshang na gzhan la snying rje bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyu'i gtso bo ma tshang ba thams cad rang la spungs te blang*/ rang gzhan thams cad de gsum dang ldan par smon lam gdab/ nyams pa med pa rnam gsum bsgom// zhes pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyi yon tan thams cad bla ma la rag las pas/ bla ma'i mos gus nyams pa med pa dang*/ blo sbyong (267)theg chen chos kyi yang snying yin pas/ blo sbyong bsgom pa la spro ba nyams pa med pa dang*/ sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya nyams pa med pa rnam pa gsum la bslab bo// 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya// zhes dus rtag tu lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa spong zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba 'bral ba med pa dang ldan par bya'o// yul la phyogs med dag tu sbyang*// khyab dang gting 'byongs kun la gces// zhes yul la phyogs ris med pa sems can dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi sogs sems can ma yin pa dang*/ mi ma yin sogs blo yul du bzang ngan gang shar thams cad la blo sbyong kho nas khyab pa dang*/ de'ang kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin pa gting nas 'byangs par bya ba gces so// bkol ba rnams la rtag tu bsgom// zhes blo sbyong dka' ba'i yul sdang ba'i dgra// gnod pa'i bgegs khyad par rang gis phan btags pa'i lan tu gnod pa byed pa'i log sgrub mkhan dang*/ rang gi 'gran zlar 'dug pa/ lhan cig tu 'grogs pa/ zhe 'gras med kyang rang bzhin gyis gnod pa/ las kyi dbang gis snying du mi sdug pa sogs la lhag par byams snying rje rtsal tu bton nas bsgom mo// bla ma dang pha ma sogs yul gnyan po la gnod par 'gyur ba'ang khyad par du spang ngo*// rkyen gzhan dag la ltos mi bya// zhes khams bzang ngan dang*/ longs spyod dkon mod dang*/ mi kha byams mi byams dang*/ gnod pa yod med sogs rkyen bzang ngan gang la'ang rags ma las par/

mthun rkyen 'dzom na 'dzom thog tu blo sbyong*/ ma 'dzom nam 'dzom pa de nyid kyi thog tu byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgom pa ste/ mdor na rang gzhan la mi ltos par blo sbyong gi rnal 'byor dang rtag tu mi 'bral ba'o// da res gtso bo nyams su blang*// zhes thog ma med pa nas lus grangs med pa blang ba thams cad don med kho nar song*/ phyis nas kyang mthun rkyen 'dzom pa 'di 'dra mi 'ong bas/ (268)da res mi lus thob/ yang dag pa'i chos dang mjal ba'i skabs 'dir tshe rabs gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub pa'i don gyi gtso bo zhig nyams su blang dgos/ de'ang tshe 'di'i don las phyi ma'i don gtso che/ phyi ma'ang 'khor ba las thar ba gtso/ rang don las gzhan don gtso/ chos bshad sgrub gnyis las sgrub pa gtso// sgrub pa gzhan las byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba gtso/ de'ang lung rigs kyi dpyad sgom las bla ma'i man ngag phur tshugs su bsgom pa gtso/ spyod lam gzhan las mal du bsdad nas sbyong ba gtso che'o// go log mi bya/ zhes pa ni/ go log drug spang ba ste/ chos sgrub pa'i dka' spyad mi bzod par dgra 'dul gnyen skyong zhing las tshong khe sogs kyi sdug bsngal bzod pa bzod pa go log /chos rnam dag sgrub pa la 'dun pa mi byed par tshe 'di'i bde skyid dpal 'byor la 'dun pa byed pa 'dun pa go log /thos bsam sgom gsum gyi ro mi myang bar zang zing longs spyod kyi ro myang ba ro myang go log /sdig pa byed pa la snying rje mi byed par chos phyir dka' thub byed pa la snying rje bsgom pa snying rje go log /rang la ltos pa'i mi chos la mi sbyor bar tshe 'di'i che thabs la sbyor ba gnyer sems go log /'khor 'das kyi bde skyid dang dge ba la dga' ba mi sgom par gzhan la mi bde ba dang dgra la sdug bsngal byung ba la dga' ba bsgom pa rjes su yi rang go log ste/ drug po de rnam pa kun tu spang bar bya'o// res 'jog mi bya/

zhes res 'ga' byed/ res 'ga' mi byed pa de chos la nges shes ma skyes pa yin pas/ blo sna mi mang ba rtse gcig tu blo sbyong bar bya/ dol chod du sbrang*/ zhes rnam g.yeng dang ma 'brel par blo sbyong kho nar blo lings kyis bskyur la phyogs gcig tu sbyang*/ rtog dpyod gnyis kyis thar bar bya// zhes rang rgyud la rgyun tu rtog cing dpyod pa gnyis kyis nyon mongs dang bdag (269)'dzin las thar bar bya dgos te/ de'ang rang rgyud la nyon mongs pa skye ba'i yul yid la byas te/ drag tu skye mi skye brtag /skye na gnyen po drag tu bsten/ yang bdag gces 'dzin ci 'dra 'dug blta/ gal te med pa ltar 'dug na chags sdang gi yul zhig bsten la brtag /de'i tshe gces 'dzin skye bar 'dug na bdag gzhan brje ba'i gnyen pos de ma thag spang ngo*// yus ma bsgom/ zhes pha rol po la rang gi drin yod kyang yus che mi bya ste bdag pas gzhan gces sgom pa'i phyir dang*/ mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang chos nyams su blangs nas dka' thub yun ring byas pa sogs rang don yin pas gzhan la yus bya don med pa'i phyir/ yus gzhan la mi 'tshong ngo*// mi la re ba mche/ lha la gsol ba thob bya ba rwa sgreng pa'i bka' yin gsungs/ ko long mi sdom/ zhes gzhan la phrag dog gi bsam pa mi bya/ gzhan gyis rang la mi mang sar sma phab pa dang*/ gnod pa byed pa sogs la lan mi bya zhing sems rgyud 'khrugs pa spang*/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ 'o skol chos pa rnams chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song bas/ bzod sran sha'u bas chung*/ ko long gtsang btsan bas dam par gda' ste/ des chos kyi go mi chod pas chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig dgos gsungs/ yud tsam pa mi bya/ zhes cung zad tsam res dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur ston pa ste grogs kyi sems la gzan pa mi bya/ 'or che ma 'dod/ zhes pas rang gis chos nyams su blangs pa dang*/

gzhan la phan btags pa dang*/ dge ba'i las byas pa sogs la gzhan gyi 'or che'i tshig gi gtong rag 'byung du re ba mi bya ste/ mdor na snyan grags yong du re ba spang ba'o// de ltar bslab bya de rnams ni blo sbyong mi nyams shing gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i thabs yin la/ mdor na rgyal sras rin po ches/ tshe hril (270)kyis byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis po mnyam rjes gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par sbyangs nas/ 'byangs pa'i gding thob par bya'o zhes gdams pa ltar 'bad do// snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba 'di// byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yin// man ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di// gser gling pa nas brgyud pa yin// zhes pa ni/ dus dang*/ sems can dang*/ tshe dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ lta ba'i snyigs ma lnga bdo bas bde ba'i mthun rkyen ni nyung*/ 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa shin tu mang bas chos gzhan gyi gnyen pos ma slebs pa na/ blo sbyong mkhan la rkyen ngan ji tsam mang bzhin dge sbyor 'phel ba dper na shing ji tsam mang bzhin me lce phyi phyir 'phel ba ltar/ nyon mongs dang rkyen ngan thams cad byang chub kyi lam kho nar bsgyur ba/ gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos/ dbang po mchog dman thams cad la phan thogs shing rgyud la 'byor ba'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po lta bu 'di/ jo bo'i bla ma rnam gsum nang nas mchog tu sku drin che ba jo bo gser gling pa nas brgyud pa'i zab chos yin no// zhes pa'o// sngon sbyang las kyi 'phro sad pas// rang gi mos pa mang ba'i rgyus// sdug bsngal gtam ngan khyad bsad nas// bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i gdams ngag zhus// da ni shi yang mi 'gyod do// zhes pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'chang kha ba nyid sngon gyi las 'phro sad nas/ chos 'di kho na la thugs mos pas dka' spyad chen pos chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang sems bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i gdams ngag 'di nyid/ jo bo yab sras kyi bka' brgyud las zhus shing thugs legs par sbyangs pas/

bdag pas gzhan gces kyi thugs rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba gtan nas med pa skyes te/ chos sgor zhugs pa'i don 'bras mthar thug pa grub cing gding thob pas 'gyod pa med pa'o// shlo ka phyi ma 'di gnyis (271)gzhung mdzad pa pos mjug sdud pa'i gsung yin no// gnyis pa brgyud pa'i gdams pas kha skong ba ni/ de ltar blo sbyong gi chos zab mo 'di rang nyid gcig pur 'dug na skyo rog yin te bde sdug thams cad blo sbyong kho nas lam du khyer chog pa ma zad/ chos zab mos las ngan lhongs nas sems lhongs su/ 'gro na sdod snying 'dod/ sdod na 'gro snying 'dod pa sogs byung na 'di ltar bsgom ste/ khyod kyi gshis lugs 'di 'dra na// gnas mal 'di yang yang rab yin// blo sems 'di yang bde mo yin// gzhan tu khyed kyi sdug sran 'dis// dmyal bar ma skyes kha rje che// btso sreg ma myong kha rje che// zhes dang*// gzhan yang 'jigs pa rab bsam ste// bdag la khrel bdas chen po bya// lto la gyong bskur dka' thub bya// gos la gyong bskur dman cha blang*// bde sdug khyad bsad gnyen po bsgom// zhes sems dpa'i rim pa las gsungs pa ltar rang la shags 'debs gnad du 'gro bar bya'o// na ba'i tshe na nad g.yog yin te/ de'ang sman pa nad g.yog 'dza' bshes sogs la 'di las drag pa zhig byed thang snyam sems yus pa'i dus su/ na ba 'di gzhan sus kyang ma lan bdag 'dzin kho nas lan/ sman dang nad g.yog gis phan na sngar 'di ma byas snyam pa med rung su'ang 'jigs pa 'di las ma thar/ da res bdag 'dzin khyod la 'di mkho bas snying tshim snyam du bsam la de'i steng du gzhan gyi nad gdon sogs len pa la bslab bo// gzhan yang jo bo gser gling pa'i gsungs las rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te/ gnyen po thams cad bcom brdeg yin// 'dun ma thams cad chig 'dril te// lam rnams thams cad gcig chod yin// gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin// (272)zhes gsungs te/

rnam rtog skyes ma thag blo sbyong ngam stong nyid kyi ngang du 'bur 'joms bya/ gnyen po thams cad phyi nas dal bus bsgom pa ma yin par nyon mongs skyes ma thag thog brdzes glo rdeg tu bcom/ 'phral phug gi 'dun ma sna kha mang po mi shoms par sems la gang ban dang bdag 'dzin brlag ci thub gcig pur bsgril/ bdag 'dzin dang nam bral na sangs rgyas pa yin pas lam gcig chod des lam rim pa brtsi mi dgos/ rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi gnyen po thams cad bsdu na chos bzhi po 'dir 'dus pa'o// rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin// 'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul ba yin// na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags shing yin// sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo longs yin// kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul= /'khor ngan log= /snyigs ma'i dus su= /zhes gsungs te/ rkyen ngan la brten nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong*/ dam pa'i chos dran pa/ rtogs pa la bogs 'don pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bya ba byed par 'gyur bas rkyen ngan spang mi dgos/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dang*/ gdon gyi gnod pa byung na dge sbyor dang thugs dam 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gyur bas bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin pas 'jigs mi dgos/ dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa la sngon gyi las ngan slong pas lus la na tsha sna tshogs 'byung yang 'byung la/ byung ba de'ang nad tshab chen po lta ci smos/ chud du klad pa na ba tsam gyis kyang thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad phyags mas 'dod pa ltar dag pa mdo las yang yang gsungs pas nad la dga' ba bsgom/ sems la sdug bsngal byung na sdug bsngal de'i ngo bo la bltas pas stong nyid du 'char/ sdug bsngal ji tsam che rung chos nyid kyi yo longs yin pas yid zhum pa mi dgos/ de rnams byung na byung gis bzang ste nyams len gyi grogs su khyer chog pas/

kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos bzhi mi spangs nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag go /(273)skyid kyi gnya' gnon chen po yin// sdug gi mjug sdud chen po yin// mi mkho shos ni 'dod thog yin// ltas ngan g.yang du len pa yin// gnyen po log gnon gyi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin// zhes gsungs te/ lus sems bde zhing skyid na chos min bya ba sna tshogs byed 'dod du 'ong bas/ skyid par snyam pa'i ngo bo la bltas pas dngos por ma grub/ skyid par snang ba tsam de sems can rnams la sbyin nas lam du khyer/ skyid snang de'i dbang du mi btang bar rang cho thub par byas pas skyid kyi gnya' gnon yin/ sdug bsngal byung na yi mug mi bya bar ngo bo la bltas pas stong par yal/ sdug snang de'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa blang zhing rang tsho thub par byas pas sdug bsngal mtha' dag gi mjug sdud pa yin// mi mkho mi 'dod pa thams cad thog tu bab na bdag gces 'dzin brlag pa'i grogs bsam thog 'dod thog yin// bdag 'dzin khyod la 'di rang mkho/ 'di cis kyang brlag tu chug cig snyam blo bde 'bol gyis bzhag /ltas ngan dang cho 'phrul byung na ci len/ gang drag snyam pa'i rnam rtog sna tshogs 'char/ de'i tshe 'di dgos rgyu yin/ byung pa legs/ bdag gces 'dzin 'di'i steng du ltas ngan thams cad spungs shig snyam du snyems 'phrig med par bzhag /gnyen po gzhan gyis ma thul ba'i log gnon gyi chos bzhi'o// bdag ni skyon gyi rtsa ba ste// rgyangs kyis bskyur ba'i chos shig yin// gzhan ni yon tan gyi 'byung khungs te// cangs te len pa'i chos shig yin// gnyen po mjug sdud kyi chos gnyis te// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin// zhes gsungs te/

mdor na blo sbyong gi rtsa ba (274)thams cad rang don rgyangs kyis bskyur ba dang*/ gzhan don cangs kyis 'jus pa gnyis la 'dus pas khrid kyi mjug don bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir/ nyams len gyi rtsa bar bzung ngo*// log cer log la cer cer ltos// shig ge shig la 'bol le zhog /des ni mi 'ching grol bar 'dod// ces pa ni/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog phra rag gang shar yang de'i rjes su 'brang nas sems phyi ru yengs na tha mal pa dang khyad med par lam log par 'gyur bas/ kha nang du cher gyis log nas ngo bo la gcer gyis blta/ bltas pas ma mthong ba'i stong nyid de'i ngang du shig ger bshig /lhod kyis klod la bzhag pas rnam rtog nyon mongs ci tsam mang rung mi 'ching zhing rang grol ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba ste/ don dam byang sems kyi bsgom rim snying po'o// de ltar jo bo rje lha gcig gi bka' srol las byon pa'i blo sbyong gi gdams ngag brgyud pa so so'i khrid srol ji snyed cig bzhugs pa'i nyams len gyi gnad don thams cad don bdun gyi gzhung 'dir 'du bas/ khrid yig rgyas bsdus mang po dang*/ de 'chad pa po mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ khyad par 'phags pa rgyal sras rin po che thogs med zhabs dang*/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po'i khrid yig dag las khrid tshul zhib mor thob pas skyes chen zung gi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i nying khu gcig tu bsdus te las dang po pas go sla gtsor bton/ gzhan phan gyi bsam pa bzang po kho nas 'dus gsal du bsdebs pa'o// mdo sngags lam gyi rtsa ba ste// dam chos kun gyi snying po'i bcud// zab cing nyams su blang bde ba// khrid tshul kun las rmad du byung*// zab chos 'di 'dra thos pa dka'// thos nas nyams su len pa dka'// 'di spyod bsod nams nor ldan pa// deng sang sa steng gser bzhin dkon// des na smra mang ngal ba'i rgyu// 'on kyang gzhan phan (275)lhag bsam gyis// 'di byas dge bas lus can kun// byang chub sems gnyis 'byong bar shog
